facts: 1,171 m up in the Brazilian Highlands
worth_knowing: Planned by Lúcio Costa and Oscar Niemeyer and founded on 21 April 1960 to replace Rio de Janeiro. It is laid out in the shape of an airplane, and became a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 1987.
